title: Augmentor authority and reasoning bridge view
description: Cross-plane view that routes candidate meaning and bounded judgment toward retained owners without allowing ontology or reasoning to authorize effects.
allowed_readings: Authority kinds route candidates to owners; they do not decide candidates.
A bounded evaluator may own reproducible derivation under frozen inputs.
A deterministic RouteDisposition and a semantic JudgmentReceipt are separate evidence objects that may inform routing but never own approval.
A current valid judgment may inform a separate route decision.
Every authority decision and protected effect requires its own exact owner and gate.
forbidden_authority_moves: RouteDisposition cannot become RouteDecision, JudgmentReceipt, or ApprovalRecord.
A positive semantic outcome cannot become an effect gate, owner, or runtime.
A transition or audit record cannot become the canonical artifact.
Private CAV2 owner bindings cannot be projected into public or product surfaces by proximity.
